dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Excuse me, could you help me? I'm looking for the City History Museum. Am I going the right way?

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: The History Museum? Hmm, let me think. Actually, you're going in the wrong direction, I'm afraid.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Oh no! How far is it from here?

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Not too far — about ten minutes on foot. Turn around and go back the way you came. Walk straight ahead for about 200 metres.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: OK, straight ahead for 200 metres. And then?

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Then turn left at the big roundabout — you'll see a tall blue building on the corner. That's the main post office.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Turn left at the roundabout, past the post office. Got it.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: That's right. Then cross the road at the zebra crossing. The museum is the large grey building directly opposite.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Cross the road and it's the grey building opposite. Is it easy to find?

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: Very easy! There's a big blue sign with the museum's name above the entrance. You can't miss it.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Wonderful. One more thing — do you know if the museum is open on Mondays?

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: I believe it's closed on Mondays. Most museums here are. You should check their website to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Good to know — thank you so much! You've been very helpful.

dialogue.speaker: Woman
dialogue.text: My pleasure! Oh, and don't forget — the museum café is excellent. The apple cake is legendary!

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Ha! Now I'm really looking forward to it. Thank you again!
